checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Small freestanding chalkboard on pavement outside café
must.why: A wooden A-frame style board stands in front of the door between the tables.

must.item: Reads exactly 'COFFEE TO GO', all legible
must.why: The text appears as three lines, 'COFFEE / TO GE / TO GO', so there is a garbled duplicate and misspelling.

must.item: Words lie on sign surface with matching perspective
must.why: Chalk text sits on the board face and looks reasonably integrated.

must.item: Plausible ground contact, scale, lighting, shadow
must.why: Scale is fine, but no clear soft shadow is visible and the board looks a bit flat and pasted on.

must.item: Original storefront, awning, tables, composition intact
must.why: The rest of the scene appears unchanged.

faults.what: Chalkboard text is wrong: extra line and 'TO GE' instead of a single 'COFFEE TO GO'.
No visible soft cast shadow on the ground; the board looks flat and slightly pasted on.
Board is fairly tall and covers the lower part of the door and window area.

summary: A well-placed chalkboard was added and the scene is preserved, but the lettering is garbled ('COFFEE TO GE TO GO') and there is no clear ground shadow.
